title: Homicidal, Suicidal, Genocidal
narrativeText: The champion stands across the ring. Sabu doesn't wait for introductions. The moment the bell rings — or before it — he is airborne. Tables. Chairs. Bodies. All of it is a weapon.

choices.label: Unleash Full Chaos
choices.text: Homicidal. Suicidal. Genocidal. The title or nothing.
